sections_target.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block. This document is for the cranes 
in the turbine hall of units Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Eid 
Lotfy, tested by eng 
Ibrahem Youssef, 
revised by quality control eng Adel Abd- El kader El Nagar at EDEPC, 
accepted by eng 
Sayed Farag:
general director, and approved 
by eng. 
Mokhtar Abd El-Latif Mady: head sector of Ataka PS

This document is accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, EDEPC Inspection and Quality Control General Director, MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Accountant Mahmoud Suleiman, EDEPC Financial Supervision and Inspection, General Director of Quality Control and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
A safety fence with warning signs surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt ...etc.

Shut down the power 
 supply of the crane.

uncertain_terms.note: Source mixes English and Arabic mid-sentence; Arabic part rendered 'as indicated by Y1 in the title block. This document is for the cranes in the turbine hall of units Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4'. The source phrase 'on an annually bases' was kept verbatim.

Source approval block is garbled and truncated (mixed Arabic/English, broken syntax, ending 'السيطرة على قطاع الرأس'); translated as best as possible from the fuller wording used in FS-033/FS-034. EDEPC = East Delta Electricity Production Company.

Manifest language is 'ar', but only about 19% of the body characters are Arabic script; the body is predominantly English. The Arabic headings, labels and fragments were translated into English and the English body was carried over verbatim, including its spelling and grammar.
